source.name: Ministarstvo prosvete open data (visoko obrazovanje), founder type = privatna ustanova

note: Open data carries no phone/email/website columns, so those are empty. The National Accreditation Body (nat.rs) was not queried; the ministry open data lists institutions holding a work licence (dozvola za rad), which is not identical to a current accreditation. Many institutions have no location record, so their row has town only (no street). extra.kind inferred from the name. One institution with no place in the register (Visoka škola Akademija za hotelijerstvo, turizam i velnes) was omitted.
